verdict.rationale: Bitbucket's own docs say it has a built-in Jira UI for managing Jira issues inside Bitbucket, and that Jira tickets can be opened from the PR screen. Commit issue keys also update Jira statuses automatically, which covers viewing, managing and opening external tickets from PRs. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation beyond marketing copy, independent or hands-on corroboration of the Jira UI workflow, and evidence of support for issue trackers other than Jira.

support.subject: As a developer, I can view and manage tickets from an external issue tracker inside the code host and open them from pull requests

citations.quote: Reduce context-switching by managing your Jira issues in Bitbucket with the built-in Jira UI.
open Jira tickets right from the PR screen
when you include your issue key in commits, your Jira issue statuses update automatically.
